extraction.Name: Charles Lunderman
extraction.NOTES: Patent was sent to him by mail; he signed a receipt for it; did not ask for the patent; was satisfied with the sale; received $6500.00 cash for the land; has six living children — one is married, another helps support himself, and Lunderman works out to support the remaining ones. Notarized before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32, on April 30, 1929. Document number 620. | TASK 5 BULK ALLOTMENT RECOVERY 2026-04-29: Sonnet text-extraction captured the allotment number from the source page header but classified it in NOTES as a 'document number' / 'Document No.' / 'No. NNNN' instead of placing it in the structured Allotment number field. The hypothesis that these document/file references are actually allotment numbers was confirmed via BLM cross-reference (exemplars: Eugene Means 2249, Lucy Patton 6802). This patch corrects 49 records via bulk regex extraction from NOTES with user-supervised review of every HIGH-confidence proposal.

recovery_notes.rationale: Source page header contained 'No. NNNN' which Sonnet captured in NOTES as 'document number' rather than placing in structured Allotment field. Hypothesis confirmed via BLM cross-reference.
